mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vfs_content_blob (content_hash, encoding, bytes, byte_len, ref_count) VALUES (#{contentHash}, #{encoding}, #{bytes}, #{byteLen}, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vfs_revision WHERE content_hash = #{contentHash}))
INSERT INTO vfs_content_blob (content_hash, encoding, bytes, byte_len) VALUES (#{contentHash}, #{encoding}, #{bytes}, #{byteLen})
mapper.select: SELECT m.offset, m.length, p.format, p.bytes FROM vfs_content_pack_member m JOIN vfs_content_pack p ON p.pack_id = m.pack_id WHERE m.content_hash = #{contentHash}
SELECT content_hash, encoding, bytes FROM vfs_content_blob WHERE content_hash IN (#{h})
SELECT content_hash, pack_id, offset, length FROM vfs_content_pack_member WHERE content_hash IN (#{h})
SELECT pack_id, format, bytes FROM vfs_content_pack WHERE pack_id IN (#{packId})
SELECT content_hash FROM ( SELECT content_hash FROM vfs_content_blob UNION ALL SELECT content_hash FROM vfs_content_pack_member ) WHERE content_hash IN (#{h})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM vfs_content_blob WHERE content_hash NOT IN ( SELECT content_hash FROM vfs_entry WHERE content_hash IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT content_hash FROM vfs_revision WHERE content_hash IS NOT NULL )

DELETE FROM vfs_content_pack_member WHERE content_hash NOT IN ( SELECT content_hash FROM vfs_entry WHERE content_hash IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT content_hash FROM vfs_revision WHERE content_hash IS NOT NULL )
DELETE FROM vfs_content_pack WHERE pack_id NOT IN (SELECT pack_id FROM vfs_content_pack_member)
mapper.select: SELECT byte_len FROM vfs_content_blob WHERE content_hash = #{contentHash}
SELECT compressed_byte_len FROM vfs_content_pack_member WHERE content_hash = #{contentHash}
